verdict.rationale: The TLD Price List API returns machine-readable pricing per TLD across multiple order types (register/renew/transfer) and pricing tiers (account, original, retail), directly enabling programmatic price comparison and budgeting; the Check Availability endpoint also returns discovery pricing per domain. Official SDKs (TypeScript, Go, PHP) provide typed access to these endpoints. Missing for 10: no public OpenAPI/swagger spec found (probe returned 404s) and no independent third-party confirmation of pricing feed accuracy/completeness.
